Message.Name: Trade Ticker Message
Message.Description: The Trade Ticker is an aggregation of several trades into one message, combining quantities of subsequent trades made on a given instrument at a given fixed price.

Field.Name: SecurityCode
Field.Description: Uniquely identifies a security available for trading.

Field.Name: TickerID
Field.Description: Unique identifier per security for each trade ticker generated. Starting from 1, incrementing by 1.

Field.Name: AggregateQuantity
Field.Description: Aggregated number of shares. Remaining quantity if TrdCancelFlag=Y.

Field.Name: TradeTime
Field.Description: Time of trade. Nanoseconds since Unix epoch UTC. Precision to microsecond. Not applicable when TrdCancelFlag=Y.

Field.Name: TrdType
Field.Description: Public trade type. Not applicable when TrdCancelFlag=Y.

Field.Name: TrdCancelFlag
Field.Description: Indicates that a trade covered in the original Trade Ticker has been cancelled.

Value.Name: Late Trade Off-exchange previous day (Public Trade Type P)
Non-direct Off-Exchange Trade (Public Trade Type M)
Direct off-exchange Trade (Public Trade Type X)
